# StopwatchPro

> StopwatchPro is a free, browser-based online stopwatch and lap timer with millisecond accuracy. No download or sign-up required.

StopwatchPro runs entirely in the browser and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile. It supports unlimited lap recording with automatic best/worst split highlighting, and continues working offline after the first page load.

## Key Features
- Millisecond-accurate stopwatch timing
- Unlimited lap recording with best/worst split highlighting
- Keyboard shortcuts: Space (Start/Stop), L (Lap), R (Reset)
- No installation, account, or sign-up needed
- Works offline after first load

## Common Use Cases
- Workout and run tracking
- Cooking timers
- Study sessions (Pomodoro technique)
- Science experiments
- Sports coaching and interval training

## Pages
- [Home](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/): Overview of all timer tools
- [Stopwatch](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/stopwatch.html): Stopwatch with laps and splits
- [Lap & Split Timer](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/splits.html): Record laps and splits, with fastest and slowest highlighted
- [Countdown Timer](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/countdown-timer.html): Countdown from a set duration, with saved timers
- [Interval Timer](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/interval-timer.html): Named work/rest steps for HIIT, circuits and study cycles
- [Alarm Clock](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/alarm.html): Multiple named alarms with selectable sounds
- [Digital Clock](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/clock.html): Large full-screen clock with date
- [Chess Clock](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/chess-clock.html): Two-sided game clock
- [Metronome](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/metronome.html): 30-240 BPM with tap tempo and visual pulse
- [Tally Counter](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/tally-counter.html): Tap counter with keyboard shortcuts
- [How to Use](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/how-to-use.html): Guide to the tools
- [FAQ](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about the tool
- [About](https://stopwatchpro.xyz/about.html): About StopwatchPro
